articles.title_original: Indonesia's vice president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
articles.title_zh: Indonesia's vice president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
facts_zh:
Indonesia's vice president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
- Published
Indonesia's Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has submitted his resignation, an aide has told the BBC, in a move which could further strain the political alliance that helped propel President Prabowo Subianto to power.
It comes after Indonesia's Supreme Court ruled that a high-school document used during Gibran's 2024 election campaign was invalid.
The ruling prompted more than 100 lawmakers to support a parliamentary initiative that could have paved the way for proceedings to impeach Gibran.

all_titles.en: Indonesia's vice president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying

articles.title_zh: Egyptian journalist's retrial adjourned as UN warns of 'assaults on press freedom'
facts_zh:
Egyptian journalist's retrial adjourned as UN warns of 'assaults on press freedom'
- Published
A criminal court in Cairo has postponed the retrial of the prominent Egyptian journalist Lina Attalah, whose case has drawn international condemnation.
Wednesday's opening hearing was adjourned until 18 November after defence lawyers representing the editor-in-chief of the news outlet Mada Masr requested a new judge.
The UN has warned of "widening assaults on press freedom by Egyptian authorities, including the targeting, persecution and harassment of independent journalists".

all_titles.en: Egyptian journalist's retrial adjourned as UN warns of 'assaults on press freedom'

articles.title_original: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
articles.title_zh: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
facts_zh:
Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
- Published
Four grizzly bears have been killed in connection with a fatal attack on a mother and daughter in the Canadian province of British Columbia.
Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, died earlier this month after going on an afternoon walk in a trail area in Bella Coola.
The British Columbia Conservation Office Service (BCCOS) launched an investigation into their deaths and forensic testing has since confirmed a sow and her three cubs were responsible for the attack.

all_titles.en: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter

articles.title_original: Haitian PM praises El Salvador after joint strike on alleged home of gang leader
articles.title_zh: Haitian PM praises El Salvador after joint strike on alleged home of gang leader
facts_zh:
Haitian PM praises El Salvador after joint strike on alleged home of gang leader
- Published
Haiti's Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aimé has praised "the commitment of the Salvadorean forces in the fight against gangs" after a joint strike on a house allegedly used by the leader of the 400 Mawozo gang.
El Salvador's President, Nayib Bukele, had earlier announced that a joint task force had "destroyed" what he described as "the house of Lanmò San Jou and the 400 Mawozo gang's headquarters".
A small contingent of Salvadorean troops has been in Haiti since January 2025 as part of a multinational force deployed to suppress gang violence.

all_titles.en: Haitian PM praises El Salvador after joint strike on alleged home of gang leader

articles.title_original: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth
articles.title_zh: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth
facts_zh:
US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth
- Published
An effort to impeach US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, accusing him of waging war on Iran without congressional authorisation, has failed on Capitol Hill.

A majority of the House of Representatives voted to refer impeachment articles to a committee - essentially killing the effort introduced by dissident Republican congressman Thomas Massie of Kentucky.
During an earlier briefing, Hegseth called the impeachment effort a "farce" and "sabotage".

all_titles.en: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth

articles.title_original: Transport workers in Chile block highways in protest over surging fuel prices
articles.title_zh: Transport workers in Chile block highways in protest over surging fuel prices
facts_zh:
Transport workers in Chile block highways in protest over surging fuel prices
- Published
Hundreds of transport workers in Chile have blocked roads and highways across the country in protest over high fuel prices.
Drivers of busses and lorries began protesting on Tuesday, gathering in convoys to halt traffic along major routes.
They are demanding a relief from surging diesel prices, which have been driven up by the war in Iran.
